Job position 

Recruitment Consultant

Role Summary

This is a full 360 Recruitment Consultant role, offering the opportunity to develop and manage your own specialist technology recruitment desk within a high-growth sector.
You will be responsible for building long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, managing the full recruitment lifecycle, and developing your own market presence within a specialist technology niche.
Whether you are an experienced recruiter looking to advance your career or someone with an established background in technology recruitment, Pearson Carter offers comprehensive training, genuine career progression opportunities, and a high-performance culture that rewards success.

Responsibilities
Candidate Management & Delivery
•	Source and engage high-quality technology professionals through our CRM, ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and market mapping activities.
•	Build and maintain a strong network of candidates within your specialist technology market.
•	Conduct candidate qualification calls and interviews to assess technical skills, experience, motivations, and suitability.
•	Manage candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing guidance, preparation, and feedback.
•	Coordinate and secure interviews between candidates and clients.
•	Negotiate and manage offer processes through to successful placement.
Client Management & Business Development
•	Develop and manage relationships with new and existing clients across Australia and the wider APAC region.
•	Conduct business development activities to identify and secure new recruitment partnerships.
•	Generate new client opportunities through networking, referrals, market research, and proactive outreach.
•	Arrange and attend meetings with prospective and existing clients, both virtually and in person.
•	Negotiate terms of business and recruitment agreements.
•	Account manage key client relationships, ensuring a high level of service and delivery.
•	Develop a thorough understanding of client businesses, hiring requirements, and market challenges.
Market Development
•	Build a recognised market presence within your specialist technology niche.
•	Develop strong networks across both candidate and client communities.
•	Stay informed on industry trends, salary benchmarking, competitor activity, and market developments.
•	Create and publish professional recruitment content across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms to strengthen personal and company branding.
•	Contribute to the growth and expansion of Pearson Carter's technology recruitment offering across the APAC region.
Operational Excellence
•	Maintain accurate records within the CRM and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
•	Manage recruitment processes efficiently, ensuring exceptional candidate and client experiences.
•	Achieve and exceed individual activity, billing, and revenue targets.
•	Collaborate with colleagues across our international offices to share market knowledge and opportunities.
 About you
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
•	Previous Recruitment experience within Technology, Software Development, IT, Digital, AI, ERP, Data, Cloud, Cyber Security, or related recruitment markets.
•	Previous Sales, Marketing or Account management experience.
•	Experience building and developing a successful recruitment desk.
•	A strong track record in sales, business development, or a target-driven environment.
•	Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
•	The ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
•	Strong networking, negotiation, and influencing abilities.
•	High levels of self-motivation, resilience, and professionalism.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	A collaborative approach and desire to contribute to a growing team environment.

For the candidate 
Full time contract
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia. 
No recruitment agencies please

Just Better Care Eastern Suburbs

Full-Time Disabilities Services Officer (Multiple positions)

About us:
Just Better Care provides in-home disability and aged care services, supporting people to live independently. We believe people of all ages & all abilities deserve access to the support and resources they need in order to live where they want and how they want. At Just Better Care, we CARE about our customers and our team. Our office covers four territories in the Sydney Metro area; Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, Sutherland and St George.
Just Better Care Eastern Suburb is looking for Disabilities Services Officer to join our caring and dynamic team. This role involves working with customers to support them in many different aspects of their day-to-day life. The role involves supporting customers with mental, physical, social and emotional disabilities. Support is provided in a manner that maintains the customer’s independence, is respectful and safe.

Main responsibility
• Demonstrate a commitment to best practice, ensuring that all services are provided in a caring and respectful way in accordance with Just Better Care’s policy and procedures.
• Assessing clients' needs and developing individual support plans
• Social support/transportation: social activities, shopping/groceries, travelling to medical appointments
• Clinical support: medication assistance
• Supporting customers in the use of aids and personal equipment including: standing or walking frames, wheelchairs, manual or electric hoists, sliding sheets or moving boards, hearing aids and other physical aids
• Supporting customers with complex and/or challenging behaviours
• Monitoring the well-being of customers and reporting on their progress
• Providing a safe environment for the client by monitoring their surroundings for potential dangers such as fire hazards and tripping hazards.
• Supporting clients socially and arranging visits or outings in the community.
• Ensuring that all documentation is completed in a timely and accurate manner. Where offices are using Mobility Options, community support workers are required to use the application for all schedule visits as per their training.
• Attending and participating in staff meetings and training sessions as directed by the Coordinator.
• Ensuring that all responsible steps are taken to protect personal safety at work and avoid adversely affecting the health or safety of any other person at the workplace in accordance with requirements under the Work Health and Safety legalisation.
• Participating in activities aimed at the continuous improvement of services.
• Complying with Just Better Care’s Vision, Values, and Purpose

What you will need:
• Qualification in the relevant field.
• At least 2 years’ relevant work experience.
• NDIS Workers Check or Police Clearance
• Current Australian Drivers Licence
• Current First Aid and CPR certificates
• Ability to be contacted by either telephone or email
• Ability or willingness to assist or work with customer in daily living and personal care skills
• Be reliable & productive
• Valuing attitudes towards customers
• Ability to work as part of a Team and maintain good working relationships
• Commitment to self-improvement
• Good written and verbal skills in English

Salary Range: $80,000 to 90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
Why Join Us:
• Close-knit team of friendly, helpful and supportive people.
• Career development and training opportunities are very high on our priority list.
• We have a vested interest in you, hence you will be well supported.
• A competitive salary is on offer for the right candidate.
• Employee Assistance Programme.
If you have any questions or would like to know more about the role, send an e-mail to hr.es@justbettercare.com

result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 


We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 


As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 


Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.





Senior Digital Business Analyst




Care, reimagined


Design and deliver innovative learning that builds clinical digital capability


Permanent, full time role, hybrid workplace model




Shape the Digital Future of Healthcare Across Victoria.




Great digital systems only deliver when they are designed around the real-world needs of the people using them. This newly created role is about bridging the gap between clinical reality and digital innovation-translating complex organizational and frontline needs into practical, high-impact digital solutions that move Monash Health toward genuine service transformation.





Make a Difference Through Digital Health


About The Role



We are now seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Digital Business Analyst to join our Innovation, Platforms and Partnership team within the Digital and Information Division.



This is an opportunity to work on some of Victoria's most significant digital health initiatives, helping transform the way care is delivered across clinical and non-clinical services. You will work alongside project managers, clinicians, technical specialists, operational leaders and executives to design solutions that improve patient care, streamline services and deliver meaningful outcomes for our community.



We are looking for someone who values teamwork, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to contribute to projects that have a genuine impact on the lives of patients, families and healthcare staff.



You will lead business analysis activities from project initiation through to solution implementation, working closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement and help deliver practical, sustainable solutions.



You will also:





Lead stakeholder engagement, workshops and requirements gathering activities across clinical and corporate services.


Develop business cases, project initiation documentation and solution proposals that support organisational priorities


Analyse business processes, workflows and service models to identify improvement opportunities and deliver measurable benefits


Work closely with technical teams to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions.


Support solution design, testing, implementation and change activities across complex projects.


Contribute to portfolio planning, resource management and prioritisation activities across a diverse digital project portfolio.






What We're Looking For



We are seeking a collaborative and community-minded professional who enjoys working with others to achieve shared outcomes.



You will bring:





Extensive experience as a Senior Business Analyst within large and complex environments.


Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of an organisation.


Experience preparing business cases, analysing business processes and developing solution recommendations.


Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, manage competing priorities and influence outcomes in complex environments.


Experience working across both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.


A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a commitment to delivering outcomes that improve services for our patients and community.





Experience in healthcare or digital health is highly regarded.






Why join Monash Health?



This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:






Lead a state-wide service with real impact


Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes








We also offer:






The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service






For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to 


Monica Lenko- Head of Digital Delivery - Monica.Lenko@monashhealth.org



To view the Position Description, click the link below


# # 8673 Senior Business Analyst PD.docx





Our Culture and Values 



At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 



Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 



You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 




We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 



We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 




If you're passionate about helping clinicians embrace digital innovation and want to influence the future of healthcare at scale, we'd love to hear from you.




Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'



Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date.
